responsibility: Centralizes the canonical definitions of CFG flag bits used on `basic_block` and `edge` objects across GCC. Included under different macros by headers such as `basic-block.h`, it assigns stable bit positions and semantics for reachability, loop, partitioning, duplication, fallthrough, abnormal/EH, executable, crossing, and other per-block/per-edge properties, so CFG-manipulation, cleanup, loop, SSA, and RTL passes all interpret the same flags consistently.
